card.name: Pharmacokinetic terms in drug labels
card.fires_on: Words in pharmacokinetics sentences about absorption, distribution and elimination, such as the start of "bioavailable", "distributed", or "elimination", and small linking words like "the" in these sentences. It also fires on "daily" after a once-a-day dose.
